children: STOXX GETS TMT LIFT, LUXURY LAGS
Falling crude prices and a pause in the global bond selloff help European shares eke out modest gains on Thursday, with the STOXX 600
rebounding from more than one-month lows.
Telecoms (.SX7P), media (.SXMP) and tech (.SX8P) rise after a mix of news including Elliott building a stake in Deutsche Telekom
seeing strong AI chip sales over the next two years, lifting the regional index 0.3%.
Luxury (.STXLUXP) is a clear weak spot as investors remain wary of a fragile demand outlook, with sector bellwether LVMH
hitting its lowest level since 2020. Energy (.SXEP) retreats, with Brent crude briefly dipping below $95 a barrel.
